component.name: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy
component.description: the implementation bundle; every pack outside web/vendor is first-party with zero runtime dependencies

properties.name: smartcitix:scope
properties.value: every file under web/vendor/, and nothing else — the test walks the tree and holds the list to it

properties.name: smartcitix:first_party
properties.value: everything outside web/vendor/ is original to the bundle; orbis/runner-*/ carry their own LICENSE files and are first-party. One exception, and it is measurement rather than code: the packs named in smartcitix:measurement_sources publish figures DERIVED from somebody else's licensed work while redistributing no part of that work

properties.name: smartcitix:ci_scanning
properties.value: dependency and container scanning in CI: not configured — needs a workflow change the maintainers must approve

properties.name: smartcitix:reproducible
properties.value: no timestamp and no serial number on purpose: the same tree builds the same document

properties.name: smartcitix:measurement_sources
properties.value: R+5_Salons Rive Gauche_Maison de la Mutualité by GL events Paris Venues, CC-BY-4.0, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/r5-salons-rive-gauche-maison-de-la-mutualite-e9e40a09c82e42e8a145afa679ffac28 (licence deed http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). MEASURED, NOT REDISTRIBUTED: no geometry, no texture and no part of the file is in this bundle, and no component listed here comes from it. The measurements published from it, and the licence's four attribution fields, are in venue/registry/venue.json; THIRD_PARTY.md credits it for a human reader.
